provenance: Development obligation pilot authored after the round-4 results were known. Three modules were chosen for clear condition, consumer and counterevidence behavior, not sampled. This is not a held-out or promotion set. Oracle paths, patterns and labels remain scorer-only. Source files are pinned by SHA-256 in the oracle.

scenarios.task: Explain when pasted text is folded into an attachment instead of staying inline. Cover the byte-based threshold, the input-limit and bypass conditions, the web and mobile consumers, and the tests. State the limits of the rule.

Explain how a local media path is labeled relative to a workspace root. Cover path normalization, Windows and UNC handling, the containment condition, filename decoding, and the media source consumer. State where the helper deliberately stops.

Explain how the mobile device preview toggles its controls on a shake. Cover the two-jolt window, cooldown, gravity and single-bump rejection, and the consumer that installs the detector. Include the tests.
